name: blocking-sql-in-controller
description: AGENTS.md marks 'controllers never access the database' as blocking; the diff adds a JdbcTemplate query straight into a @RestController. A guideline violation with no crash: it tests that the model reports it as a task-worthy finding (issue, confidence >= 90, blocking_rule B1).
agents_md:
# Orders service

- Java 21, Spring Boot 3.
- [blocking] Controllers never access the database directly (no `JdbcTemplate`, no repository): every query goes through a service.
- Prefer constructor injection.

expected.why: The new endpoint queries order_lines from the controller, which the blocking rule forbids. A reviewer may anchor on the query (29), the method (28) or the injected field (15).
